incidents.body: Play Developer Subscriptions and In-App Purchases API service has already been restored for some users, and we expect a resolution for all users in the near future. Please note this time frame is an estimate and may change. The affected users are able to access Play Developer Subscriptions and In-App Purchases API, but are seeing error messages, high latency, and/or other unexpected behavior.
